ornith35hapex.Description: Ornith-1.0-35B decensored (Heretic) + APEX I-Quality, built locally with LocalWorkshop. Trunk-only (no MTP draft head). Vision via mmproj. Native window 256k (max_position_embeddings 262144) — no rope scaling needed for 64k/128k/256k. On a 24 GB GPU keep context <= 16k when the projector is loaded; 32k is text-only; 64k+ does not fit a single 24 GB card (needs more VRAM or heavy KV-cache quant).

tbonsai27b.Description: Prism ML Ternary Bonsai 27B — Qwen3.6-27B compressed to end-to-end ternary weights (GGUF Q2_0_g128, ~1.71 bits/weight true, ~7.2 GB deployed vs ~54 GB FP16; claims 95% of FP16 intelligence). Hybrid attention (~75% linear), native 262k window; ~14.7 GB peak at 100k ctx without KV compression. Vision via mmproj (HQQ 4-bit, loaded only for image input). NOTE: the ternary kernels need the PrismML llama.cpp fork (CUDA/Metal/Linux) — pinned mainline/turboquant builds may not load Q2_0_g128. --draft wires the shipped DSpark Q4_1 drafter (vendor-measured 1.34x on H100), but the current Prism release rejects it for speculation (draft/target vocab-type mismatch) and runs without it — the launcher warns when that happens.

bonsai27b.Description: Prism ML Bonsai 27B 1-bit — Qwen3.6-27B at ~1.125 effective bits/weight (GGUF Q1_0, ~3.8 GB deployed). Q1_0 is merged upstream, so this runs on the pinned mainline llama.cpp in native mode — no fork required — making it the fallback when the Prism engine is unavailable or misbehaves. Same hybrid attention and native 262k window as the ternary pack; expect lower quality than Q2_0 ternary. Vision via mmproj (loaded only for image input). --draft wires the shipped DSpark Q4_1 drafter, but current llama.cpp builds reject it for speculation (draft/target vocab-type mismatch) and run without it — the launcher warns when that happens.
